decision: GO for exactly one official private standalone check; no decoder integration or public promotion authorized by this review
critic_actions: Independently rehashed frozen candidate and verifier, read complete parent/candidate diff, actual wgs_seg control flow, host resource block and entire verifier.

Confirmed only CUDA_SRC and _ext differ at Python AST level. Full CUDA normalization restores parent after removing the exact new host diagnostic block and reversing intended bank/wait/release/assert edits.
Checked all 20 indexed AF accesses use ci&3 while NTT1 accumulator parity remains ci&1, explicit initial bank0 operands and mma0 conditions remain unchanged.
Checked GS2, eight commit groups per stage, four AF banks and three weight/X ring slots. Bank q&3 is not reused until its old group q-4 has retired under wait2.
Checked previous-X release occurs after ci1 wait2, when both previous-stage trailing groups have retired; terminal wait0 and final-X release are preserved.
Checked FCI3 deferred flush, final generic accumulator accesses, epilogues, split fixups, ring participants, producers, PDL ordering, geometry, grid and scratch remain unchanged.
Checked both exact BIG specializations are queried with the real thread count and dynamic shared memory; opt-in and occupancy errors fail before launch, and occupancy>=1 is mandatory for both.

Read the final native verifier's deferred operand-pointer retention, descriptor/AF/first-write/accumulator trace and X-slot checks; confirmed these execute extracted source rather than only a duplicated schedule model.

source_test_scope.pending_state: pd.kind=1 with a stubbed preceding drained-segment flush; u=0, s0=0, slot=-1
source_test_scope.epilogue_scope: Native execution ends after terminal drain/X release; unchanged remaining epilogue and fixup source is verified by exact normalization.
source_test_scope.abstract_lifetime_support: experiments/iterations/20261104-wgs-wait2-lifetimes-critic-rerun.json: 13,872 cases, 3,662,208 groups, 53,856 flush boundaries and three failing unsafe negative controls

limits: CPU mocks use synthetic decode values and do not emulate tensor numerical arithmetic, CUDA/PTX compilation, actual compiler register allocation or full-grid GPU scheduling.
The native test uses seven representative threads, one s0 and one pending kind; do not describe it as exhaustive thread or pending-state coverage.
Unchanged arithmetic instruction order and operand traces are strong source evidence, not a replacement for official numerical checks on actual GPU.

The unchanged NVIDIA occupancy-header proof establishes that the 576-thread kernel's register-admission cap is 96, not 112. Additional logical AF liveness may force spills or serialization despite unchanged source geometry.
WGS verbose build output may still be truncated by the official log tail. No visible C7512/C7510 warning does not prove their absence.
Prior GS4 and aggregate NCU wait counters do not establish this mechanism's speed or resource outcome.

official_gate.required: All correctness checks pass; actual both-specialization occupancy>=1; retain source hash, complete receipt and available compilation/resource/profile evidence.
official_gate.interpretation: Compare affected cases and unchanged controls against both private and scored exact-parent runs. Inspect raw and normalized timings and baseline drift, not aggregate score alone.
official_gate.publication: A useful standalone result would require a separate exact decoder integration source review and official check before public scoring.
